salons.name: Maison Leish Haute Makeup Atelier
salons.tagline: Haute couture bridal, red carpet & VIP gala makeup artistry
salons.description: Maison Leish is our flagship luxury makeup studio, renowned for bespoke bridal looks, red-carpet complexion sculpting, and camera-ready luxury artistry. Founded on Parisian couture aesthetics, our master MUAs tailor every stroke, contour, and highlight to your unique bone structure and skin undertone.

services.name: Royal Bridal Glam & Touch-Up Kit
services.description: Includes luxury skincare prep, custom waterproof airbrush base, 3D mink/silk lashes, lip sculpting, and a custom VIP bridal touch-up kit.

services.name: Red Carpet Gala Contour & Radiance
services.description: High-definition sculpting, luminous glass skin finish, bespoke eye design, and 18-hour transfer-resistant setting.

services.name: Bridal Glam Trial & Artistry Consultation
services.description: Comprehensive bridal trial testing lighting variations, skin compatibility, and veil/jewelry color harmony.

salons.name: L’Éclat Makeup & Airbrush Lab
salons.description: L’Éclat is an avant-garde makeup atelier specializing in precision airbrush technology and high-fashion editorial styling. We create seamless, poreless skin finishes that look effortless in daylight and flawless under high-intensity 4K cameras.

services.name: 4K Ultra-HD Airbrush Artistry
services.description: Micro-fine airbrushed foundation with custom pigment matching, sweat-resistant silicone veil, and sculpted cheekbones.

services.name: High-Fashion Editorial & Graphic Wing
services.description: Bold runway color gradients, chromatic pigments, precision winged liner, and sculpted brows.

services.name: Editorial Photoshoot Day-Rate Package
services.description: On-set makeup artistry with 3 full look changes and continuous camera touch-ups for studio photography.
